title: Folded desktops can acquire duplicate reorder ranks
detail: Folded empty desktops are missing from reorder bounds. Drag the first occupied desktop below the last occupied one while a named empty desktop follows. The app sends last-occupied/none; the store can assign the folded desktop's rank to the moved desktop. Opening the folded desktop and dragging between the now-tied rows fails because the rank interval is empty. Independently confirmed; isolated store probe on s-zy7kp3. Map visible seams to full-order adjacent bounds and handle existing ties.
